ttft_ms.explanation: True Time To First Token: measured arrival of the first non-empty text token chunk at the Observer API.

mean_itl_ms.explanation: Mean inter-token latency derived from consecutive streamed token arrival timestamps.

p95_itl_ms.explanation: 95th percentile inter-token latency derived from streamed token arrival intervals.

decode_tokens_per_sec.explanation: Decode throughput derived from post-first-token generation window.

e2e_tokens_per_sec.explanation: End-to-end output token rate derived from total completion tokens divided by total request duration.

total_duration_ms.explanation: End-to-end request duration measured by the Observer API.
